fullTextZH: 很多人都很喜欢圣诞节。
圣诞节的时候你做什么？
fullTextEN: What do you do during Christmas?

fullTextZH: 你要买很多很多礼物吗？
fullTextEN: Do you want to buy many, many gifts?

fullTextZH: 或者你收很多很多礼物。
fullTextEN: Or do you receive many, many gifts?

fullTextZH: 如果圣诞节是你的传统节日，
fullTextEN: If Christmas is your traditional holiday,

fullTextZH: 可能你和你的家人一起过 ，
fullTextEN: maybe you celebrate with your family,
maybe you have a Christmas meal.
I don't know what you eat.

fullTextZH: 因为圣诞节不是我的传统节日，
fullTextEN: Because Christmas is not my traditional holiday,
So what do Chinese people do?
In Chinese, we call it Christmas Eve,

fullTextZH: 对，中国人在平安夜吃苹果。
fullTextEN: Yes, Chinese people eat apples on Christmas Eve.

fullTextZH: 因为平安夜听起来像苹果，
fullTextEN: Because Christmas Eve sounds like apple,

fullTextZH: 对，可是在圣诞节前一天，
fullTextEN: Yes, but on the day before Christmas,

fullTextZH: 很多中国人真的会送朋友很多苹果，
fullTextEN: Many Chinese people really give friends many apples,

fullTextZH: 圣诞节的时候我们做什么？
fullTextEN: What do we do during Christmas?

fullTextZH: 我觉得我们没有做什么特别的东西。
fullTextEN: I think we don't do anything special.

fullTextZH: 那我听说在日本和中国不一样，
fullTextEN: Then I heard it's different in Japan and China,

fullTextZH: 日本人在圣诞节的时候吃肯德基，
fullTextEN: Japanese people eat KFC during Christmas,

fullTextZH: 我觉得可能因为日本人想吃火鸡，
fullTextEN: I think maybe because Japanese people want to eat turkey,

fullTextZH: 火鸡。可是日本没有很多火鸡，
fullTextEN: Turkey. But Japan doesn't have much turkey,

fullTextZH: 肯德基做了很多很多广告，
fullTextEN: KFC did a lot of advertising,

fullTextZH: 肯德基叫所有人来吃肯德基。
fullTextEN: KFC told everyone to come eat KFC.

fullTextZH: 你觉得吃苹果奇怪还是吃肯德基奇怪？
fullTextEN: Do you think eating apples is strange or eating KFC is strange?

fullTextZH: 好，那我听说犹太人也不一样，
fullTextEN: Okay, so I heard Jews are different,
Jews can only eat Chinese food,
The Chinese restaurant is still open,

fullTextZH: 对，所以犹太人去吃中国菜。
fullTextEN: Right, so Jewish people go to eat Chinese food.
Jewish people will go to eat Chinese food.

fullTextZH: 圣诞节的时候很冷很冷，
fullTextEN: It's very, very cold during Christmas,

fullTextZH: 因为圣诞节的时候是冬天，
可是在澳大利亚是夏天，
所以很多很多澳大利亚人喜欢去海边，
fullTextEN: So many, many Australians like to go to the beach,

fullTextZH: 那澳大利亚人吃什么啊？吃烧烤，
fullTextEN: So what do Australians eat? They eat barbecue,
Maybe you also find it very strange.

fullTextZH: 所以在圣诞节吃什么最奇怪？
fullTextEN: So what's the strangest thing to eat at Christmas?
Which one do you think is the strangest?
Leave a comment and tell me,
